decided_by_rule: funding/tools/check_funding_deadlines.py: an OVERDUE application must be SUBMITTED, DECLINED, WITHDRAWN, SUPERSEDED or AWARDED
funding/coordination/funding-tasks.json claims[].release_condition: release by a committed no-go decision; expected_evidence: submission receipt or no-go receipt
fail-closed: no submission receipt exists (dates.submitted_at is null), so SUBMITTED/AWARDED cannot be recorded; no qualified lead applicant is recorded, so SUPERSEDED cannot be recorded

six_field_record.failed_predicate: application submitted before dates.deadline by authorized organizational authority
six_field_record.required_evidence_or_repair: none for this cycle; a future cycle of the same program opens a new application record and a new claim
six_field_record.next_attempt: next published cycle of the same opportunity
